Agentic AI Booklet

October 2025

Foreword

Generative AI is transforming the way we work, create, and get entertained. It has put us in a position to build systems, which can generate text featuring complex narratives, produce advanced code in almost arbitrary programming languages, and create image and video artwork alongside matching soundtrack and audio effects at steadily increasing levels of quality and sophistication.

While this generative revolution is still in full flow, another transformation is already emerging: The move from passive AI waiting to be prompted to take its next action to Agentic AI – systems that can plan, reason and act on complex, multi-step tasks autonomously, without human intervention.

This booklet is designed to equip its target audience of AI product managers and executives with a solid understanding of the current state, potential and challenges of the rapidly advancing field of Agentic AI. It explains its core concepts and underlying technology, offers a comprehensive overview of the ecosystem, and concludes with an outlook on key trends, risks and challenges associated with Agentic AI.

As with all things AI, progress in this field is swift. This booklet aspires to provide a timely snapshot – a guide to understanding today’s Agentic AI landscape and preparing for what might come next.

Dr. Carsten Mönning Vice President Technology & Bertelsmann AI Hub Lead, Bertelsmann SE & Co. KGaA AIHub@bertelsmann.de

Introduction Motivation and Objectives

Motivation

Agentic AI represents the next evolution of Generative AI: Systems that not only generate outputs, but reason, decide, and act. Building on GenAI capabilities, agentic systems combine LLMs with tools, memory, and feedback to autonomously complete multi-step tasks.

Driven by rapid developments by both ecosystem players like LangChain and LlamaIndex and established tech companies such as Microsoft and Google, Agentic AI is already reshaping business processes and workflows across many industries. Bertelsmann units are actively piloting use cases or are already using Agentic AI in production – from content search and customer service to software engineering agents.

Objectives

The main objective of this booklet is to: - Offer a clear and practical definition of Agentic AI – what it is and how it works, both conceptually and technologically

\- Provide an overview of the current Agentic AI ecosystem, including key players and industry leaders

\- Share our learnings at Bertelsmann from early applications

\- Outline emerging trends, as well as potential risks and best practices to consider for the next steps

Fundamentals | Concept – Agentic AI extends established AI capabilities with access to tools and resources to enable autonomous AI at scale

Paradigm

Description

Exemplary Systems

Traditional AI

Rule-based or machine learning systems designed for narrow, well-defined tasks. Following a fixed logic, these systems do not generate new content or act autonomously beyond pre-defined behaviors

Generative AI

Machine learning models capable of generating new content by learning patterns from vast datasets. Aspiring to simulate human cognition, these systems can create text and software code as well as audio, images and video

Agentic AI

Systems, which may integrate classical machine learning, Generative AI and external resources & tools to plan and carry out multi-step tasks with minimal human intervention. Agentic AI marks the shift from passive response generation to autonomous task execution

To date, there is no universally accepted definition of “agents” and definitions vary widely: From fully autonomous systems capable of planning, acting, and learning, to pre-defined, task-oriented workflows 'only'.

A more practical view is to understand agents as existing along a spectrum of autonomy, ranging from structured, pre-defined workflows to highly adaptive, self-directed systems.

summary:
O Agentic AI Booklet, publicado em outubro de 2025 pelo Bertelsmann AI Hub, oferece uma visão abrangente sobre a evolução da Inteligência Artificial Agêntica. O documento explica como a IA está passando de sistemas passivos e reativos — que apenas geram respostas quando solicitados — para sistemas autônomos capazes de planejar, raciocinar e executar tarefas complexas em múltiplas etapas sem intervenção humana constante. O livro foi elaborado para gestores de produtos de IA e executivos, com o objetivo de equipá-los com o conhecimento necessário para entender o estado atual e o potencial dessa tecnologia em rápida evolução.

O booklet está estruturado em cinco partes principais: Introdução, Fundamentos, Ecossistema, Perspectivas e Apêndice. Na seção de Fundamentos, são explorados os conceitos centrais da IA Agêntica, diferenciando-a da IA tradicional (baseada em regras para tarefas bem definidas) e da IA Generativa (modelos que criam conteúdo a partir de padrões aprendidos). A IA Agêntica é apresentada como uma fusão de aprendizado de máquina clássico, modelos generativos e ferramentas externas, formando sistemas que operam em diferentes níveis de autonomia — desde fluxos de trabalho pré-definidos até sistemas altamente adaptativos e autodirecionados.

O documento também apresenta um panorama do ecossistema de IA Agêntica, destacando atores-chave como LangChain, LlamaIndex, Microsoft e Google, além de relatar as experiências pioneiras da própria Bertelsmann com aplicações em produção — incluindo busca de conteúdo, atendimento ao cliente e agentes de engenharia de software. Por fim, o booklet conclui com uma análise prospectiva sobre tendências emergentes, riscos associados e melhores práticas para empresas que estão iniciando sua jornada com IA Agêntica, posicionando o documento como um guia prático e atualizado para navegar nesse campo em constante transformação.
